The City of Allen offers a one-time service to collect
empty fattened and stacked cardboard boxes.
Packing paper may also be placed in a labeled

noon on Friday for Saturday pickup.

HOLIDAYS
Trash and recycling will not be collected on these
holidays; collection will slide one service day after
the holiday, ending with a Saturday pickup:
• January 1: New Year's Day
• May 25: Memorial Day
• September 7: Labor Day
• November 26: Thanksgiving
• December 25: Christmas Day*
*Five extra trash bags may be placed 2 feet away from
your cart on your frst service day after Christmas.

SEVERE WEATHER
If severe weather will impact your
trash and recycling collection, the
information will be shared on AllenTX.
gov, CommunityWasteDisposal.
com, and on Allen City Television
(ACTV) available on Frontier Channel
15, Grande Channel 15 and Spectrum
Channel 16.
Following a severe weather event,
City staff will determine if the amount
of debris meets the requirements to
trigger a city-wide cleanup effort. A decision will be
made within 72 hours of the weather event and will be
posted at AllenTX.gov.
